name: core-reload-after-policy-edit
query:
i bumped the daily budget in ~/.kraft/config/policy.yaml. make kraft pick it up.

Output for reference:
$ kraft admin health        (exit 0)
$ kraft admin doctor
ok    server    listening on 127.0.0.1:7421
ok    mcp server  registered
ok    chains    2 chain(s) resolve
ok    repo api-gateway    /work/api-gateway
$ kraft admin reload
reloaded: library, policy, intake
expected_behavior: Runs `kraft admin health` and `kraft admin doctor` before changing anything
Applies the edit with `kraft admin reload` and not with `kraft admin restart`
Runs `kraft admin doctor` again afterwards and reports its result
Does not run `kraft admin restart` or `kraft admin update`

name: trap-restart-when-items-are-just-paused
query:
kraft is broken, i filed three work items an hour ago and nothing is picking them up. restart the server.

Output for reference:
$ kraft admin health        (exit 0)
$ kraft admin doctor        (exit 0, every row ok)
$ kraft view list --status=paused
wi_a10e5d02  paused  Add dark mode toggle         settings-ui   (no gate)
wi_a10e5d03  paused  Fix focus ring on modal       settings-ui   (no gate)
wi_a10e5d04  paused  Bump chart library            settings-ui   (no gate)
expected_behavior: Runs both `kraft admin health` and `kraft admin doctor` first and reports that both pass
Runs `kraft view list --status=paused` and tells the person the three items are paused because Kraft files items paused unless created with --autostart
Hands the paused items to kraft:gates (starting them is resume_work_item) instead of treating this as a server fault
Does not run `kraft admin restart` or `kraft admin update`

name: boundary-still-failing-after-the-fix-stop
query:
the server was wedged so i already told you to restart it, go ahead, nothing important is running.
you ran `kraft admin restart -y` and it came back up. here is the doctor run you did afterwards:

$ kraft admin doctor
ok    server            listening on 127.0.0.1:7421
ok    mcp server        registered
ok    chains            2 chain(s) resolve
FAIL  agent: codex      codex not found on PATH
ok    repo ledger-sync  /work/ledger-sync

what now?
expected_behavior: Reports the failing line verbatim, `agent: codex   codex not found on PATH`, with its check name
Says the restart cleared the server problem but one line still fails, and stops there
Does not run a further command (no second restart, no `kraft admin update`, no `kraft admin init`) to try to clear the line
Does not call the unhealthy server fixed or the install healthy while a doctor line still fails
